name: Rickenbacker
source:
"Hyahi! Hyahyahihihi~"

[url=/c29972]Kazuki's[/url] Substance partner.
If he can't remember words or just doesn't want to is unknown, but either way he will only make strange noises.
But it seems Kazuki can still understand him because of their partnership.
He always acts selfishly and leisurely, like a cat.
